summary: the cases of tests/run exitline under etude, against a kernel that logs every exit, one that logs none, and one that gives a killed init's record the tag of an exit

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 tests && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel

faults.name: loud
faults.summary: every process's exit is logged, on a root with an init as well as under the debug shell

faults.name: silent
faults.summary: no process's exit is logged, under the debug shell either

faults.name: signal-tag
faults.summary: the record of an init killed by a signal is tagged sys_exit, not terminate

edits.find:
klog(KLOG_INFO, "terminate",
             "init process %d killed by signal %d, returning
edits.replace:
klog(KLOG_INFO, "sys_exit",
             "init process %d killed by signal %d, returning
